To determine the latest date by which ballots must be mailed so they arrive on time for a vote scheduled on [insert date], you would need to know the specific deadlines and processing times for ballot delivery in the relevant jurisdiction (e.g., state, county, or local election office). Ballot deadlines can vary significantly depending on whether the election is in-person, early voting, or mail-in voting, as well as the specific rules of the governing body.

If you provide the specific jurisdiction or election details, I can help you find or explain how to determine the deadline.
